sources.title: (Mis)Fitting: A Survey of Scaling Laws

concluding_discussions_review.scope: Selected developments and model boundaries, rather than an exhaustive survey. Suggested future experiments in the notes are author synthesis, not established findings.

completed_note_structure.references: Each article now contains its own annotated bibliography; shared manifest retains cross-article mappings.
completed_note_structure.independent_examples: New interpolation, composition, factor-dynamics, Markov and lifecycle calculations are independent worked examples, not paper experiment reproductions.
